programme.title: Pantbanken på turné
programme.desc: The pawnshop's experienced appraisers embark on a tour of the country in search of unexpected treasures. Gold, jewelry, art, vehicles.

programme.title: Högspänning

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: After a key witness and a U.S. marshal are ambushed and killed, Maggie and OA must find the man who leaked the information that led to their murders.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: A prison break by an inmate who had just three weeks left on a sentence compels the team to reopen the case of a naval officer's death.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Sam Hanna goes rogue from the NCIS team in an attempt to stop Tahir Khaled from ever targeting his family again.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Jamie continues to hunt Murtagh and his band of Regulators, with a dedicated lieutenant and a contingent of redcoat soldiers at his side.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Afterwork TV

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Det store skillet
programme.desc: Når Aang og vennene hans kommer til kanten av et kjempejuv, blir de bedt om å hjelpe to grupper av fanger over.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Stormen
programme.desc: En karftig storm bringer tilbake smertefulle minner om fortiden - og setter alle i fare i nåtiden.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Den blå ånden
programme.desc: Etter at Sokka og Katara blir syke fordi de har vært ute i stormen, prøver Aang å finne en kur og oppdager at han trenger noen frosne frosker for å få dem kurert.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Spåmannen
programme.desc: Aang, Katara og Sokka oppdager en landsby av folk som alle er avhengige av en spåmann i deres daglige liv - men de er så avengige at de er blinde overfor den umiddelbare fare de alle står overfor.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Bato og vannstammen
programme.desc: Aang føler seg usikker når Katara og Sokka møter på noe som minner dem om dere hjem. Fordi Aang tror at vennene hans kan komme til å forlate ham, skjuler han en viktig beskjed som bare fører til trøbbel.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Desertøren
programme.desc: Aang prøver å fiine en Ildtemmende herre for å lære ham mens Katara finer ut at han har spesielle krefter.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Det nordlige Lufttempelet
programme.desc: Etter å ha rørt ryktene om overlevende Luftbøyere, reiser barna til det nordlige Lufttempelet for å se det med egne øyne. Hva de ser der kan bety katastrofe for alle fiendene av Ildnasjonen.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Vannbøyemesteren
programme.desc: Barna når de nordlige Vannstammen, og Aang og Katara ser etter en Vannbøyemester i det Sokka faller for en prinsesse. Samtidig planlegger Zhao et angrep og Zuko må finne en måte å fortsette sin jakt på Avataren.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Beleiringen av Nordpolen del 1
programme.desc: Den Nordlige vannstammen gjør seg klar for et angrep fra Admiral Zhaos marineflåte. I kampens hete kjemper Aang for å forsvare byen. Han lurer på om det ikke finnes en bedre måte å bruke sine Avatar-evner.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Beleiringen av Nordpolen del 2
programme.desc: Zhaos invasjon bryter seg gjennom den ytre skansen av den Nordlige Vannstammens forsvar, og han avslører en ondskapsfull plan.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Avatartilstanden
programme.desc: Aang og gruppen møter en Jordkongerikegeneral som ønsker å bruke Aangs kraftfulle "Avatar-tilstand" som et våpen for å beseire Ildnasjonen. Men å komme inn i "Avatar-tilstanden med hensikt er vanskeligere enn det Aang tror.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: De to kjæresters grotte
programme.desc: På deres vei til Omashu møter barna en gruppe nomader som viser dem en snarvei gjennom "de to kjæresters grotte".

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Returen til Omashu
programme.desc: Barna vender tilbake til Omashu slik at Aang kan lære Jordbøying av kong Bumi. Men når de kommer dit, blir de sjokkert over å finne ut at byen nå er på Ildnasjonens hender. Til tross for faren, går Aang inn i Omashu på leting etter kong Bumi.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Sumpen
programme.desc: Når barna ender opp i en mystisk og underlig sump, blir frykten deres blottstilt. Og Aang lærer om å bli "knyttet til jorden av en usannsynlig lærer.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Avatardag
programme.desc: Aang må fjerne en bølge av anti-Avatar synspunkter og sone for noe han gjorde i fortiden.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Den blinde banditt
programme.desc: På leting etter en Jordbøyelærer for Aang, drar barna til en underjordisk Jordbøyeturnering, hvor de møter Toph, en blind, men mektig Jordbøyer.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Zuko alene
programme.desc: På reise uten sin onkel, vandrer Zuko nå av sted inn i en Jordkongerikeby, hvor han knytter bånd med en lokal gutt. Samtidig blir Zuko hjemsøkt av minner fra sin egen ungdom.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Jakten
programme.desc: Barna blir nådeløst forfulgt av en mystisk maskin, og deres utmattelse får dem til å gå i strupen på hverandre.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Surt arbeid
programme.desc: Når Aang strever med et hinder mens han prøver å lære Jordbøying fra Toph, lurer han på om problemet ligger hos ham eller hos hans lærer. Samtidig havner Sokka i en knipe.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Biblioteket
programme.desc: En professor leder barna til et åndebibliotek midt i ørkenen, hvor Sokka håper på å oppdage nye hemmeligheter som kan brukes mot Ildnasjonen.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Ørkenen

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Slangepasset
programme.desc: Gruppen samler seg så rundt et kart for å diskutere i hvilken retning de bør dra - Slangepasset ser ut til å være den mest direkte ruten.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Boren
programme.desc: Aang oppdager et hemmelig Ildnasjons våpen som har retning rett mot Ba Sing Se, og må stoppe det før det ødelegger den store muren som beskytter byen mot en invasjon.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Byen med murer og hemmeligheter
programme.desc: Aang og barna kommer endelig frem til Ba Sing Se for å treffe Jordkongen, bare for å oppdage mystiske styrker inne i byen som prøver å stoppe dem. Samtidig prøver Jet å finne beviser på at Zuko og onkel er Ildnasjon.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Fortellinger om Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: En serie med korte historier belyser forskjellige karakterer og deres individuelle eventyr i byen. Historier om Katara og Toph, onkel Sokka, Aang, Zuko og Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Appas tapte dager

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Laogaisjøen
programme.desc: Når de leter etter Appa, møter barna på Jet, men er usikre på om de skal stole på ham eller ikke. Samtidig er Zuko også på jakt etter Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Jordkongen

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Guruen

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Ole Jørgen og Gina er førstegangskjøpere på begrenset budsjett, og drømmer om en fredfull og landlig enebolig til seg og kattene. Oda og Simon har noen spesielle utfordringer med sin nåværende bolig.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 901
programme.desc: Toppblogger Isabel Raad har tidligere leid leilighet for 29 000 kr i måneden. Nå skal hun kjøpe sin aller første bolig, men klarer Karianne å finne noe som kan leve opp til de skyhøye forventningene?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 903
programme.desc: Hanne kjøpte drømmeboligen som viste seg å være infisert av både rotter og skjeggkre. Etter sitt forrige bomkjøp håper hun at Hans Christian kan hjelpe. Og Christian skal kjøpe sin første leilighet.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 302
programme.desc: Louise og Michael har vokst ut av sin lille leilighet i Århus og trenger mer plass. Paret gjør et kompromiss, og Louise står overfor sitt største mareritt i huset som ekspertene kjøper til dem.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 303
programme.desc: Charlotte og Mikkel bor i en så liten leilighet at dusjen må tømmes for ting hver gang de skal bade. Men nå ønsker de å flytte litt ut av byen sammen med sønnen deres.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så lite at hvis de trenger litt privatliv, så har de bare toalettet å ty til. Nicklas drømmer om å få et kjøkken med to ovner, slik at han kan lage mer mat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor allerede bra, i en leilighet som har en utrolig utsikt. Men en kommende familieforøkelse betyr at de må finne noe som er større.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise får sjokk når de ser hvilke hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen jobber overtid for å prøve å oppfylle parets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia ønsker å flytte litt utenfor byen - men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads sin hjelp kjøper de en bolig som har nøyaktig alt de ikke liker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 401
programme.desc: I første episode møter vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende åtte millioner å kjøpe hus og pusse opp for. Men det store budsjettet har ikke hjulpet dem så langt - kan ekspertene være til hjelp?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 402
programme.desc: Ekspertene drar til Hørning, der presten og hennes familie trenger et nytt sted å bo. De leier et lite rekkehus og nå vil de gjerne flytte.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om å bytte ut sine lille leiebolig på Nørrebro med en murervilla i Hillerød. Men de angrer bittert på at de har spurt ekspertene om hjelp når de får se huset pengene gikk til.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små barn - og en drøm om å bo sammen med besteforeldrene. Så ekspertene leter etter et hus som har plass til to familier, med plass til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke nok plass i den lille Frederiksberg-leiligheten etter en familieøkning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er store, så selv med 7 millioner finner de ikke det de er ute etter.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen faller i bakken med et brak. Ekspertene må jobbe hardt før den lille familien - forhåpentligvis - kan flytte inn i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to barn har tatt over hjemmet, og det er leker overalt. Løsningen er et større hjem, men paret har ikke klart å finne det rette huset enda. Nå får de hjelp av ekspertene, men det blir ikke lett.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte rekkehuset sitt i den tro at de snart skulle finne det rette huset. Men sånn gikk det ikke. Paret er utrolig kresne, og har høye krav. Kan ekspertene skape hjemmet som Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to barn leier i Humlebæk, og de er mildt sagt lei av det. De mangler plass, hage - og de vil også ha barn sammen snart. Men to års husjakt har ikke gitt resultat.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Aptitude and Natural Talent
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Poise and Composure
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Style and Presentation
programme.desc: The girls find out they're getting makeovers in a Lisa Mail. This weeks challenge is a bucking bronco advertisement for the cheesy "Britain's Next Top Model Hairspray". In this weeks photoshoot they have the added element of working with a small dog.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Character and Personality
programme.desc: The girls took part in a challenge for Jai Kudo glasses. At the photoshoot the models are greeted by Gerry Deveaux and Giorgio Guidotti, of Italian fashion house, Primarni for a shoot for the latest collection by SportMax one of Max Mara's labels.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Exhibition and Spectacle
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Drama and Performance
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Intelligence and Originality
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Imagination and Creativity
programme.desc: The girls pose as different types of mannequines for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Stamina and Endurance
programme.desc: The girls are put through a series of circus acts and asked to model on plinths in London's streets. The girls also pose for beauty shots in Zandra Rhodes dresses in the style of sporting events.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Beauty and Cover Girl
programme.desc: The girls start the week by attending a casting session with Sadie Frost and Jemima French. They meet up with Caroline Barnes and Sophie Beresiner for a beauty editorial and the photoshoot is for the cover of Company Magazine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Semi-Finals
programme.desc: In the penulimate episode of Cycle 4, the girls arive in South Africa and they participate in an African themed photoshoot. In the end one girl is sent home to the UK.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Finals
programme.desc: In the finale the girls do one last photoshoot with animals in the South African bush. Then, after one girl is eliminated, the girls participate in an African runway show and 'Britain's Next Top Model' is crowned.

programme.desc: Gumball og Darwin prøver å hjelpe Ocho med sinnemestring og oppdager at livet hans er mye vanskeligere enn deres.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Tilbakekomsten
programme.desc: Far må få barna opp tidsnok til første dag tilbake på skolen. Men han forsov seg, og kan ikke finne Gumball, Darwin eller Anais noe sted.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Erkefienden
programme.desc: Gumball og Darwin oppdager at Rob, som sverget å ta hevn over dem, legger feller som aldri fungerer. Barna vil hjelpe Rob å bli en bedre erkefiende.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Gjengen
programme.desc: Når Gumball og Darwin bestemmer seg for at det er tid for å bli med i en gjeng, blir de enige om at det kuleste crewet i Elmore er Senior Borgerne.

programme.title: Regular Show: De glemte videoene: God mann spiker
programme.desc: Muscle Man avslører sin hemmelige fortid.

programme.title: Regular Show: De glemte videoene: Stylterne
programme.desc: Rigby vil seriøst ta et bilde.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Alt man kan spise
programme.desc: Jake ber Finn om hjelp til å vinne en pølsespisekonkurranse, men Finn sliter med samvittigheten når han ser hva som befinner seg inne i Jake sin mage.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Forbanne-ord
programme.desc: Finn oppdager at Jake har begravd demonforbannelser i hagen. Nå må Finn overtale vennen sin til å konfrontere demonene sine, bokstavelig talt.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Hjerneprosenter
programme.desc: Cyborg blir sittende fast i en alternativ virkelighet av Natten begynner å skinne med en drage som vil stjele sangen til sine egne onde formål.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: BL4Z3
programme.desc: Titans blir hackere for å stoppe en gjeng med datapirater.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Varmt salatvann
programme.desc: Tedrikking får Titans til å bli britiske, og det er opp til Robin å redde Amerika fra en ny britisk invasjon.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Likasjon
programme.desc: Robin introduserer de andre for en applikasjon de kan tjene penger med, men de lærer snart hvor farlig det er med delingsøkonomi.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Stille
programme.desc: Finn og Jake blir lammet fra halsen og ned og i Iskongens vold!

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Trollmannskampen
programme.desc: Hvert andre århundre samler trollmennen i Ooo seg til "Trollmannssport", et fantastisk, kongelig oppgjør kun for trollmenn.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Det som manglet
programme.desc: Kom bli med! Nå skal vi ut på tur med hunden Jake og gutten Finn igjen. Så bli med om du tør.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Epletyven
programme.desc: F & J føler seg sultne og bare en ting kan tilfredsstille sulten deres.

programme.title: The Regular Show: Dårlig portrett
programme.desc: Mordecai og Rigby ødelegger et viktig maleri av Benson, og er nødt til å fikse det.

programme.title: The Regular Show: Postkortet
programme.desc: Hi-Five Ghost ønsker å gjenforenes med ei jente fra fortiden.

programme.title: The Regular Show: Video 101
programme.desc: Eileen, Mordecai, Rigby og CJ vil lage en musikkvideo til Eileens filmklasse.

programme.title: The Regular Show: Sommertid
programme.desc: Mordecai og Rigby må stille alle klokkene i parken til sommertiden.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Pinlig
programme.desc: Gumball synger oppslukt om ketsjup og holder på å kræsje med Pølsefyren. De oppdager gjennom den pinlige situasjonen at de er på vei i samme retning.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Reiret
programme.desc: En reporter forteller familien Watterson at naboene har forsvunnet. Letingen fører dem til et merkelig egg, som de oppdager tilhører Onde Skilpadde.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Poengene
programme.desc: Tobias gjør det bedre enn Gumball og Darwin i nettspillet Galatrek. Han innrømmer at han tjener "gode poeng" ved å gjøre oppgaver for foreldrene sine.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Røttene
programme.desc: Familien Watterson prøver å få Darwin til å få kontakt med fiskerøttene sine

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Tower of Power
programme.desc: Cyborg kortslutter når han blir våt, så de andre demonterer ham sånn at han skal tørke.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Parasitt
programme.desc: Starfire får en romparasitt og insisterer på å behandle den som et kjæledyr.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Starfires løgner
programme.desc: Starfire er den eneste av titans-gjengen som blir invitert til dansefesten til Titans øst.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Straffen
programme.desc: Gumball og Nicole sverger hevn på sjåføren av en bil som kjørte på rødt lys.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Roasten
programme.desc: Etter at Gumballs provoserende harselas gjør ham til latter foran hele byen, lover han å legge bort sitt kritiske blikk på alt og alle.

programme.title: Totally Spies!: Rotekopper
programme.desc: Singapores gater fylles med søppel. Mens spionene kjemper for å rydde opp i kaoset, stresser Alex med å imponere sin ryddige trener.

programme.title: COPS: Mommy's Tears
programme.desc: A suspect collides with another driver while fleeing from police, deputies mediate an altercation over a bag of chips, and officers respond to a domestic dispute.

programme.title: COPS: Running Scared
programme.desc: Suspected jewelry thieves attempt a daring escape during a pursuit, a man gives officers a challenge during his arrest, and a traffic stop puts a marriage in jeopardy.

programme.title: COPS: Time to Climb
programme.desc: A couple flee a routine traffic stop. An intoxicated woman climbs a tree. Construction workers are pulled over for a hand-to-hand transaction.

programme.title: COPS: Dine and Flee
programme.desc: A sting operation is set up to catch narcotics dealers. A man flees a restaurant without paying his four-hundred-dollar tab. A traffic stop for a tint violation leads to a felony arrest for narcotics.

programme.title: COPS: Gas up and Run!
programme.desc: A man is tasered twice after struggling with two deputies. A gas station fight ends in a foot chase. A deputy pulls over a pair of quarreling lovers after they run a stop sign.

programme.title: COPS: Settled with a Pipe
programme.desc: A man attacking a woman is tackled by an officer. A vehicle is pulled over for a drug deal in progress. A woman smashes a car window with a pipe in a fit of road rage.

programme.title: COPS: Dyed in the Wool
programme.desc: A suspect selling narcotics takes off on foot. A bank robber leaves his wallet in an abandoned money bag. Multiple domestic violence calls end in arrests.

programme.title: COPS: The House Always Wins
programme.desc: A suspect runs from an illegal gambling game claiming shots were fired. A man is caught trespassing on school grounds. A male driver wearing a halter top is pulled over for a minor traffic violation.

programme.title: COPS: Allergy Season
programme.desc: A drunk driver rams into a pursuing police car. A man on a bike flees an area known for drug activity on a bike. A sniffling man attempts to hide a baggie with narcotics under his shirt.

programme.title: COPS: Yard Work
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a call of a man shooting a gun in his front yard. Officers are called to a domestic dispute over an wrinkly infant's shirt. Four armed and suspicious men are spotted by deputies.

programme.title: COPS: Keep it Down!
programme.desc: An officer is forced to subdue a suspect with his baton. A man asks deputies to give him back his drugs before taking him to jail. A man causes a disturbance at an apartment complex.

programme.title: COPS: Hot Potato
programme.desc: A man tosses his stash after being pulled over. Officers question two men in a fight who live with the same woman. A man says his shorts are from a thrift store after drugs are found in them.

programme.title: COPS: Nerves of Noodles
programme.desc: A man tells deputies the pants he has on aren't his. Officers are called to the scene of men firing an ak-47. A nervous driver fesses up to the deputy who stopped him.

programme.title: COPS: What's Your Deductible?
programme.desc: Detectives chase a suspect who wrecks his car. Police are called when a man headbutts his neighbor. Officers tend to a woman punched in the face by her husband while on the bus.

programme.title: COPS: Wardrobe Malfunction
programme.desc: A suspect flees police in a truck over a misdemeanor traffic warrant. A man denies hitting his wife who has a bloody nose. A man denies ownership of his shorts when deputies find drugs in them.

programme.title: COPS: High Speed Golf
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a truck with a trailer full of golf carts. Police question a driver after finding a mask and handgun in his car. Officers are called to a traffic collision involving a semi and an SUV.

programme.title: COPS: Bumper Cars
programme.desc: A man rams his wife's car into his daughter's car. Deputies find a rifle in a suspect's car that was in a prior altercation. A man claims to run a travel business after cops find evidence of id theft.

programme.title: COPS: Doggie Dispute
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a man wanted in connection with a family violence call. Detectives are called to a dispute between neighbors over an unleashed dog.

programme.title: COPS: Rocks in my Socks

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Pressure Cooker
programme.desc: De siste jentene sendes snart hjem og noen som er i faresonen må lære seg den berømte DCC-entréen, men treningen øker ikke akkurat deres sjanser til å komme på laget.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Game Day
programme.desc: Jentene har en siste sjanse før deres skjebne avgjøres. Drømmer begynner å bli til virkelighet når jentene poserer for lagbildet. Det bys på fantastisk dans når show-gruppen og resten av troppen opptrer for første gang.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Følg med og se hvem som kommer til å klare de vanskeligste danseuttakene i sportsverdenen. 500 kvinner satser alt for drømmen om å bli en av de berømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders for 2014-2015-sesongen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dancing For Your Life
programme.desc: 55 jenter i toppklasse har kommet seg til finalen, noe som bekymrer de 30 veteranene som nå må kjempe for en plass i troppen. Kitty Carter holder ikke tilbake når hun forbereder jentene på å danse sine soloer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Welcome to Valley Ranch
programme.desc: Når treningsleiren åpner med 43 kvinner, blir presset stort! Kellis entusiasme er smittsom, men det første møtet er også opprørende. Forventningene er skyhøye. Syv jenter må eliminieres for at troppen skal bestå av 36.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Week Of Firsts
programme.desc: Frykt griper treningsleirkandidatene når de innser at de må klare DCCs benspark og hoppspagat for første gang. Å lande så unaturlig krever stor tro på seg selv.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Getting The DCC Look
programme.desc: For å være en DCC må man se ut som en DCC. Denne uken skal Kelli sørge for at alle jentene har den rette looken. De begynner med en makeover og jentene drar til snobbete Halcyon Salon for å få nye frisyrer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Time To Get Serious
programme.desc: Kandidatene starter sin sjette uke og de må begynne å se ut som DCC, eller så kan de risikere å miste plassene sine. Melissa Rycroft og tidligere DCC Tina Kalina vikarierer for Judy og Kelli for å se kandidatene med nye øyne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Lucid Dream
programme.desc: Det er tre jenter igjen å sende hjem og den første kampen er rett rundt hjørnet, så trykket er enormt når jentene vender tilbake til AT&T Stadium for å innta banen for første gang siden uttaket.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Payoff
programme.desc: Det er treningsleirens siste dag og alle er nervøse for at Kelli og Judy skal velge ut en tropp med færre enn 36 medlemmer. Etter noen tøffe beslutninger forvandles skrekk til glede når sluttroppen kunngjøres.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dare To Dream
programme.desc: Denne sesongen har 400 jenter våget å drømme stort at de kan bli en av de verdensberømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. De satser alt når de preliminære uttakene for 2015-2016-troppen begynner.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dance Your Heart Out
programme.desc: Tjuetre veteraner melder seg på uttaket for å konkurrere mot 59 nybegynnere som vil ta plassene deres. Talent og utseende er ikke nok for å sikre en plass i troppen. Drømmer både går i oppfyllelse og knuses når kun 46 kommer seg til leiren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: An Emotional Beginning
programme.desc: Treningsleiren begynner og Kelli sier hvor skapet skal stå. Noen av jentene bryter sammen når de innser hvor vanskelig det er å bli en DCC. Melissa Rycroft gir dem håp og råd om hvordan de skal klare seg.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Cuts Begin
programme.desc: Kelli og Judy må sende ti jenter hjem for å komme ned til troppens magiske 36. Tilpassingen av drakter viser Kelli hvem som har alt. Når de begynner å sende folk hjem, knuses drømmer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Becoming World Class
programme.desc: Jentene får DCC-looken, som er til hjelp for noen, men ikke andre. To gjester overrasker på treningen og rocker DCCs verden. Kelli opplever en av de pinligste kontorsbesøkene noensinne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Having A Bad Day
programme.desc: Cameo- og showgruppe-uttak presser de nye og veteranene til bristepunktet. Melissa Rycroft forsøker å redde en DCC som henger i en tynn tråd, og et besøk på Kellis kontor avsluttes på en sjokkerende måte.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Cutting Board
programme.desc: Følelsene stormer når Kelli og Judy må ta vanskelige valg og sende folk hjem for å beholde troppens kvalitet. Melissa Rycroft deler ut uvurderlige råd.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Living the Dream
programme.desc: Kelli kunngjør endelig troppen. Skader truer starten på Cowboys treningsleir. Kaos på kampdagen kan ødelegge for jentene når opptredenen må være feilfri.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Drømmen starter
programme.desc: Hundrevis av vakre og talentfulle håpefulle ankommer for å prøve å bli verdens beste heiagjeng. Samtidig søker mange av jentene som må dra, forsoning.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Nydebut-jentene
programme.desc: Veteranene kjemper for plassene mens de nye prøver å leve drømmene og gjennomgå treningsleiren til DCC. De stilles overfor panelintervjuer, soloer, en slitsom dansekombinasjon og et rom med tøffe dommere.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dette er sværingene
programme.desc: De nye kandidatene får en tankevekker om hva det innebærer å være en DCC. Jentene kjemper for å lære dansene. Melissa Rycroft treffer nykommerne for første gang.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Time to Push
programme.desc: With the first cut looming, the girls must push their dance skills to the limit; Melissa Rycroft works to bring out showmanship; stress increases on makeover day as the girls try to get the DCC look.

programme.desc: A new choreographer shakes things up; uniform fittings and the Belk fashion show approach; two-time Grammy winner Kacey Musgraves stops by rehearsal.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fallon's Father
programme.desc: Alexis forteller Cecil Colby at Fallon er datteren hans. Blake og Steven oppfordres til å skvære opp. Dr. Toscanni trekker en bevisstløs Steven opp av bassenget og sender ham på sykehuset i all hast.

programme.title: Dynasty: Reconciliation
programme.desc: Steven vender tilbake til herskapshuset for å komme seg etter skadene han fikk da han falt. Krystles niese, Sammy Jo, kommer for å tilbringe noen uker hos Carrigton-familien.

programme.title: Dynasty: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Nick forteller søsteren sin at Blake har skylden for at broren deres døde. Sammy Jo og Steven tilbringer natten sammen. Alexis skyter på Krystles hest.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Miscarriage
programme.desc: Krystle mister babyen. Steven og Sammy Jo begynner å date, selv om Steven er forelsket i Claudia. Fallon fortsetter forholdet med Nick, og blir sjalu når hun oppdager at han besøker Krystle på sykehuset.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Mid-East Meeting
programme.desc: Fallon finner ut at hun er gravid, og forteller Jeff at hun skal ta abort. Han går med på å skille seg, men bare hvis hun beholder barnet. Krystle sørger fortsatt over tapet av babyen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Alexis lurer Blake til å komme til Roma og narrer ham i en felle ved å leie en snikfotograf til å ta suspekte bilder av dem. Jeff bønnfaller Fallon om å ikke ta abort.

programme.title: Dynasty: Sammy Jo and Steven Marry
programme.desc: Nick forteller Krystle at han elsker henne. Steven og Sammy Jo gifter seg. Fallon avlyser aborten. Etter skandalen forårsaket av paparazzibildene av Alexis og Blake, forlater Krystle Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Car Explosion
programme.desc: Nick overtaler Krystle til å gå fra Blake. Steven og Sammy Jo kunngjør at de er gift. Blake angripes av gangstere og blir blindet når bilen hans bombes.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blake's Blindness
programme.desc: Blake er fortsatt blind etter eksplosjonen. Nick ber Krystle om å skille seg fra ektemannen og gifte seg med ham. Blake graver i Nicks fortid. Alexis er fast bestemt på å fordrive Krystle fra Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Hearing
programme.desc: Fallon forteller Nick at hun elsker ham, men han er interessert i Krystle. Blakes forsøk på å stille Logan Rhinewood for retten mislykkes.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Iago Syndrome
programme.desc: Krystle tar farvel med Nick og forlater Denver. Blake tilbyr seg å adoptere Jeff. Cecil utsetter Claudia for utpressing. Nick godtar Blakes forklaring av brorens død.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Party
programme.desc: På en fest til ære for Sammy Jo, flauer Sammy Jo ut Carrington-familien og forteller Fallon at Blake ikke er faren hennes. Jeff forlater festen sammen med Claudia. Blake forteller Krystle at han kan se igjen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Baby
programme.desc: Fallon får en sønn. Alexis tilbyr Sammy Jo $25 000 å forlate Denver. Jeff og Claudia ligger sammen. Krystle anklager Alexis for å ha myrdet babyen. Alexis får vite at Krystle og Blake ikke er lovformelig gift.

programme.title: Dynasty: Mother And Son

programme.title: Dynasty: The Gun

programme.desc: Claudia legges inn på sykehus etter skytehendelsen. Krystle dras inn i saken. Logan Rhinewood fortsetter å kjøpe opp Devner-Carrington. Cecil frir til Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Shakedown

programme.title: Dynasty: The Two Princes

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 706
programme.desc: Med utsikt over hele Glomfjord ligger varmestua til Glomfjord Alpinanlegg. Denne slitne plankebua trenger sårt litt kjærlighet, og gutta snører på seg skiene og tar fatt på oppdraget.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 707
programme.desc: I Rennebu ligger det en gård med en gammel tømmerhytte som ser ut som et feriehus i Karibia. Gutta vil finne tilbake til husets sjel, så her må de tenke kreativt.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 708
programme.desc: Fra stuevinduet i årets siste hytte ser man rett opp mot Gaustatoppen. Gutta får seg en stor overraskelse når de skal sette inn større vindusflater, men hytta blir likevel lun og koselig med nærkontakt til naturen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 801
programme.desc: I sesongens første episode går turen til vakre Orre på Jæren utenfor Stavanger. Her er det planer om store forandringer. Halvor tar gutta med på surfing, og bofasilitetene denne uka er nok litt utenom det vanlige.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 802
programme.desc: Gutta drar til avsidesliggende Ytre Fure på Stadlandet. Her skal de forvandle en gammel sveitservilla til et idyllisk og praktisk sommerhus. Halvor lærer Ole å legge tapet, og det skjer også et spennende prosjekt under det gamle fjøset.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 803
programme.desc: Urke er ei lita bygd like ved Hjørundfjorden. Her ligger Eventyrlig Oppussings første «A-frame»-hytte. Praktiske oppbevaringsløsninger står på lista, og Ole lager en hev/senk-trapp man aldri har sett maken til.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 804
programme.desc: Gutta reiser til Finnmark for første gang, nærmere sagt Bugøynes. Her sammenlignes hytta med «huset på prærien» og stikkord som «ville vesten» og «ralph lauren» setter stilen. Ole får lekt seg med gamle materialer, og Halvor setter malingsrekord.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 805
programme.desc: Rett utenfor Halden ligger Aremark, og her gir et ungt par Halvor frie tøyler på skogshytta si. Torkel feller et tre som blir brukt til både benk, bord og kunst. Halvor overrasker gutta med øksekast-konkurranse, og Ole bygger spisebord av tømmer.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 806
programme.desc: Med utsikt over Vågå ligger årets vinterhytte. En typisk 80-talls furuhytte skal tilpasses den yngre generasjonen og gutta tar utfordringen på strak arm. Halvor viser hvordan man kan gjenbruke gamle vinduer, og hjemmesnekrede møbler får nytt liv.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 901
programme.desc: I sesongens første episode går turen til nydelige Rott i Tananger. Her er det et gammelt jærhus som skal pusses opp. Gutta snur om på planløsningen, og Ole bygger en koselig utedo.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 902
programme.desc: I denne episoden går turen til det populære hytteområdet Hvaler. Her skal gutta forvandle en sjelløs hytte til et maritimt paradis.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 903
programme.desc: Ytterst på et svaberg ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger en hytte du knapt kan se. Her gjenbrukes mer enn vanlig, men hytta er likevel ikke til å kjenne igjen når uka er omme.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 904
programme.desc: Gutta reiser til Hurum for å pusse opp en bitteliten hytte med mange trange rom. Det skal åpnes opp, og hytta skal selvfølgelig få ny farge. Halvor viser hvordan man kan gjenbruke møbler.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 905
programme.desc: Rett utenfor Stavanger ligger Randøy, og her finnes ei hytte med en litt uvanlig fasong. Eierne sliter med en stor trapp som tar mye plass, men det har gutta en løsning på.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 906
programme.desc: Med utsikt over Åsenfjord ligger et lite hyttetun bestående av 3 hytter. Her er det en storfamilie som ønsker seg et finere fellesområde utendørs, samt en oppussing av den eldste hytta.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 907
programme.desc: Endelig er Eventyrlig Oppussing tilbake på Svalbard. Hytta de skal pusse opp ligger med utsikt over Adventdalen og gruve 7. Gutta får kjenne på dramatikk når en isbjørn er observert i området.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 908
programme.desc: Den vakre fjellbygda Vingelen er kledd i vinterdrakt, og gutta skal pusse opp en gammel seter. Ole er som alltid kreativ i sine løsninger og Halvor vil fornye hytta uten å miste sjelen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing
programme.desc: Turen går til den skjulte perlen Hovden i Vesterålen. Huset kjent som «det gule huset» skal pusses opp. Vil Halvor beholde gulfargen? Og hvordan kan man kombinere 1930-stilen med moderne løsninger?

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing
programme.desc: I denne episoden går turen til sommerparadiset Portør. Her må gutta være kreative for å lage et deilig uteområde til tross for strenge regler fra kommunen. Klarer de det?

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing
programme.desc: I tredje episode pusser gutta opp noe de aldri har vært borti før – nemlig en tunnel! Er det virkelig mulig å gjøre en grotte om til et lunt sted man ønsker å henge med familie og venner?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Shag Pad Invasion
programme.desc: Geordienes hjemmefester er legendariske - drikke seg dritings, hooke, og det er alltid noen sannheter som kommer frem, men er det slutten på festen for Grant og Abbie? Sam ser rødt når Chloe koser med Alex, men Nathan ler sist og best.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Look Who's Back
programme.desc: Holly ankommer med storm - fra fortiden. Nathan tar med sin indre Peter Andre til klubben og Spphie tar ut sine flørteegenskaper. Begge blir varme og svette, men av helt forskjellige årsaker. Etter at Sam blir venner med Chloe, går han for langt?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Queen Nathan's Birthday
programme.desc: Holly er bekymret for Chloe, men Chloe vil bare gi Sam en lærepenge. Alle drar på en tur i outbacken til Nathans bursdag, men hva synes lokalbefolkningen om fire menn i drag? Sophie tar det med ro når hun tar med sin drag queen til sengs.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Geordie
programme.desc: Gjengen våkner i villmarken og kaster seg ut i lokale skikker som saueklipping og mat fra bushen. En kveld på den lokale strippebula fører til at Abbie får tips og Sophie går fullt inn for å få mannen sin. Tilbake i Goldie venter det en ny Geordie!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sam Busts His Hand
programme.desc: Sophie og Alex våkner etter å ha fått avtalen i boks. Sophie er glad, men Alex tviler. Nathan ser rødt når Alex tar en avgjørelse og så er det igang. Sams hånd får ham på sykehus, så Chloe drukner sine sorger, og det skikkelig!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Pride Party
programme.desc: Gjengen feirer Pride som bare geordier kan med alle husfesters mor - og en overraskelsesgjest! Sophie ender i tårer og Chloe er ikke imponert over Alex. Sam kommer tilbake og Abbie og den nye fyren Adam nærmer seg hverandre.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gotta Have Faith
programme.desc: Geordie-gjengen er tilbake på hjemmebane og klare for å skape mer leven enn noen gang. Denne gangen får de besøk av noen gamle kjenninger, noen nye ansikter, og venner og familie mens de gjør seg klare til å male byen rød igjen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Dinner Party
programme.desc: Chloe og Sam viser fram sitt nye hjem når de inviterer gjengen på innvielsesfest. Nathan vakler når han skjønner at han må jobbe på Scotts første jobb. Faith oppdager snart at ikke alt bare er en stor fest når hun støter sammen med Chloe.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Girls Trip
programme.desc: Sophie bestemmer at jentene trenger en sammensveisings-ferie i Blackpool, mens guttas forhold aldri har vært så ille. Faith snakker ut med Chloe, men det er ikke sikkert at hun husker særlig mye neste morgen!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sophie And Sam Fall Out
programme.desc: Gjengen kunne ikke hatt det bedre etter turen til Blackpool, men det endrer seg når de er tilbake i by'n. Faith blir uvenner med Nathan og spenninger mellom Sam og Chloe renner over og gjør at de pakker kofferten.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It's Snowing In Newcastle
programme.desc: Abbie og Adam sliter med vennskapet og Nathan føler seg sviktet av Chloe som setter kjæresten Sam, først. Faith føler seg omsider som én av gjengen, og Scott tar med gjengen på dykking i tank.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Benidorm Bound
programme.desc: Geordiene prøver seg på burlesk dans og inviterer venner på en spillkveld. Anna sender dem til Benidorm. Gjengen gjør furore på The strip, men Sophie slår Sam etter at han enda en gang kaller henne sjalu.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nana Joins The Gang
programme.desc: Sophie ber om unnskyldning for å ha slått Sam og geordiene har en herlig dag i vannparken. Gjengen drar på klubb med Abbies bestemor, og det er akkurat det som trengs for å sveise familien sammen igjen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Double Return
programme.desc: Sophie mister munn og mæle når Alex fra Australia kommer på overraskelsesbesøk. Det er god stemning i huset når Holly kommer tilbake og tar med gjengen til Newcastle Pride for fest, drikking og dansing!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly Gets A Shock
programme.desc: Chloe tar med Sam på en hemmelig date som gjør at det går kaldt nedover ryggen hans. Alex må fornedre seg for Sophie, og Scotty T gjør livet pinlig for Holly da han tar med hennes ekskjæreste Kyle på jobb.
